speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are experiencing agitation and have noticed a yellowish tint to your skin and eyes; can you tell me if you have been feeling any pain, fever, or changes in your urine or stool color recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 20-year-old male. The patient was previously healthy and has been brought to the emergency department due to agitation over the past 24 hours. Family members have noticed a yellowish coloring of his skin and eyes over the past week. The patient has a history of occasional cocaine and ecstasy use, and drinks alcohol socially on weekends. The patient also admits to high-risk sexual behaviors without using appropriate protection.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Hepatitis B with superimposed acetaminophen toxicity from recreational drug use.

I will request further imaging and lab results to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Liver_function_panel, Coagulation_profile, Acetaminophen_level, HIV_status, Hepatitis_serologies, Complete_Blood_Count. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_Ultrasound.
